content.short: BALANCE - a Blockchain Intelligence app dedicated to supporting the Cardano Blockchain Ecosystem
content.description: The core mission of BALANCE is to provide deep insights into the decentralization of the Cardano blockchain ecosystem. We aim to acheive this mission by creating impactful data visualizations developed through strong collabotration with community members dedicated to imporving decentralization within the Cardano blockchian ecosystem.
